subject: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Morales <sophie.morales@randstad.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

Team —

I ran a first-pass on consolidating overlapping role scopes across the Serving Runtime and Platform teams. The goal is to reduce duplicated ownership for operational runbooks and to create clearer escalation lines for on-call and postmortems. This is sensitive because it touches senior IC scopes and dotted reports.

Attachments: role-scope-matrix-v1.xlsx (Excel), org-redraw-annotated.pdf (PDF)

High-level summary: 
- Propose collapsing Compute Ops ownership under a single Lead (temporary title: Compute Operations Lead) moved from Platform to Serving; this reduces 3 partial owners to 1.
- Shift model-variant rollout ownership to a Product-Platform split: Product owns staging policy; Platform owns canary infra.
- Create an escalation buffer role ("Resilience Liaison") to coordinate cross-pod incident comms.

Asking for a quick read + two things by EOD Wednesday: 1) flag any irreversible scope changes, 2) nominate one person you think is a strong temporary lead for Compute Ops while we run a 60-day pilot.

This doc is confidential — please keep distribution to the thread and Sophie (Randstad) for HR advisory. I will schedule a short sync to walk through the matrix.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

Thanks for the thoughtful draft, Mina — I scanned the matrix. A few quick notes: 

- The proposed Compute Operations Lead makes sense operationally, but we need to check manager spans if this person will be doing both hiring and day-to-day incident work. If this becomes a manager role we should avoid creating an accidental people manager loop with existing EMs.
- On the model-variant split: we should avoid splitting accountability for rollbacks. Can we add a clear rule in the matrix: "Platform has final rollback authority for infra-related regressions; Product owns model acceptance criteria for quality regressions."

Nomination for temporary lead: I want to suggest Priya Natarajan for the pilot (she's not on the thread because this is sensitive). She has the context and has done cross-pod work. If you want me to approach Priya, I can do it if we agree on the scope.

Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

Appreciate the outline, Mina. Two operational considerations from my side: 

1) Headcount offsets — If we centralize Compute Ops, do we plan to move current FTEs or reassign responsibilities? The matrix has suggested pairings but not the resourcing timeline. I want to avoid surprises at performance review time.

2) Postmortem ownership — The "Resilience Liaison" role should be explicitly non-managerial (IC) to respect career ladders; otherwise we create promotion blockers.

I'm happy to join the sync if we can include a short annex that maps proposed changes to the upcoming review window (April-June).

Regards,
Jonas
Head, Platform

---

From: Sophie Morales <sophie.morales@randstad.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

Thanks for including Randstad for advisory. A few legal/comp constraints to flag from our side: 

- Any reassignment that materially changes role scope for existing employees should be accompanied by a documented "scope change" conversation and a 30-day notice where local labor laws require it. We can help draft a neutral script.
- For temporary pilots that change reporting lines, maintain written consent from affected ICs where possible. This preserves options for performance calibration during reviews.
- If there will be any title changes, treat them as separate from performance rating decisions — do not conflate in the review communication.

We can prepare a one-page HR playbook for the pilot that includes scripts, timeline, and a checklist for legal signoffs. I should get the list of impacted people (preferred anonymized ID list ok) before drafting.

Sophie
Senior Consultant, Randstad Consulting
(Attachment: hr-pilot-playbook-template.docx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Morales <sophie.morales@randstad.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

Thanks all — good feedback. Action items: 

- Karthik: please confirm whether we should approach Priya confidentially; if yes, I will coordinate. (Due: Fri 26 Mar)
- Jonas: I will add a resourcing annex mapping to the April-June review window and propose wording that separates title decisions from performance outcomes. (Due: Mon 29 Mar)
- Sophie: please draft the one-page HR playbook; anonymized list of impacted ICs attached will be provided by end of day today.

I am scheduling a 30-minute walkthrough: Thu 25 Mar 10:00-10:30 PT. If that conflicts, propose an alternate slot. The meeting invite will be internal-only (we'll loop Sophie for the HR annex follow-up).

Confidentiality reminder: do not forward outside this group.

Mina
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: anonymized-impacted-list.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Role-scope rationalization + HR touchpoint (confidential)

I'll be on the walkthrough Thu 25 Mar. Quick note: for the pilot, please ensure we document the fallback plan if the Compute Ops Lead pilot doesn't meet SLOs — e.g., reassign responsibilities back with a 14-day rollback window. That will reduce anxiety during review conversations.

Laura
Head, Talent & People Programs
